• Replacement Filters: Our system uses 20-micron or 30-micron filters to capture dirt, hair, and debris. We recommend changing the filter about once a month to keep the water crystal clear and protect the chiller.
• Water Maintenance Supplies: Basic water care supplies (like test strips and sanitizer) keep your water clean and safe without frequent draining.

Here are the core tips for a safe and comfortable first cold plunge:
• Start Moderate: Set your water temperature around 50°F to 55°F for your first few times rather than jumping straight into extreme cold.
• Aim for 2–3 Minutes: A short session of 2 to 3 minutes is all you need to get the full mental and physical benefits when starting out.
• Focus on Breathing: Control your breath with deep, slow inhales and longer exhales to calm your nervous system and help ease the initial cold shock.
• Warm Up Naturally: Ease into the cold slowly without diving, and warm up naturally with light movement or warm clothing afterward.
